claims.text: The separator of this stage (the identity-structure profile P and its comparison) is defined using only the frozen G1 document v1.1's terms (the candidate state, the projection π and its sequence table T, projection-equivalence under §2.3, the exercised inventory) and the skeleton's D5 form. No physics result, no register or ledger quantity, and no quantity defined against a recorded corpus's profile is a component or a premise of the definition. This does not establish: that P is a good separator — only that its definition stands on the G1 document's terms, as D-090-3 requires of everything this study derives.
